name: Future Floodplain 2020s
description:
This dataset contains mapped floodplain information for a 2020s future scenario, with 4,484 sampled records and 10 fields. Each record represents a flood zone polygon or related feature, carrying identifiers (id, target_fid, orig_fid), geometry measures (shape_leng and shape_area), and flood hazard attributes. The fld_zone field classifies zones as AE (about 62% of non-missing values), VE (about 37%), or AO (about 1%), though roughly three-quarters of records have no zone assigned. static_bfe gives a base flood elevation value, and abfe_0_2pc appears to hold a projected 0.2-percent-annual-chance flood elevation. gridcode stores a categorical or depth-related code ranging from 0 to 2500, and join_count records how many source features were combined into each record.

The data could support flood risk assessment, land-use and emergency planning, insurance or permitting screening
